name: iraqi-eval-set-2026-10
writtenBy: Iraqi Arabic Language and Voice Engineer, 2026-10-04

fields.text: what the engine speaks, Baghdadi Iraqi Arabic as written in the studio (گ and چ as such; digits only where the line tests digit handling)
fields.gloss: a plain English gloss for a reviewer who does not read Arabic
fields.features: the dialect features the line tests (tag key in the document, §2)
fields.sex: the expected speaker: M, F or ANY (spoken by every voice of the run)
fields.msaWouldSoundWrong: true when a Modern Standard Arabic reading of this line would be audibly wrong to a Baghdadi ear (dialect fidelity, not just intelligibility)
fields.source: who wrote the line and where it comes from
fields.rawDigits: true when the text carries digits on purpose: the harness speaks it raw and prepared (--prepare both)

lines.text: شلونك؟ شخبارك؟ شكو ماكو؟
lines.gloss: How are you? What's your news? What's up?

lines.text: هلا والله، تفضل اگعد. شنو تشرب، چاي لو گهوة؟
lines.gloss: Hello and welcome, sit down. What will you drink, tea or coffee?

lines.text: تعال نگعد بالگهوة شوية، ما عدنا شغل اليوم.
lines.gloss: Come, let's sit at the café a while; we have no work today.

lines.text: هاي الحچاية طويلة، خليها لباچر.
lines.gloss: This story is long, leave it for tomorrow.

lines.text: عندي شغلة بسيطة، تگدر تجي ويّاي للسوگ؟
lines.gloss: I have a small errand; can you come with me to the market?

lines.text: اكو واحد يسأل عليك بالباب، اگله يفوت؟
lines.gloss: There's someone asking for you at the door; shall I tell him to come in?

lines.text: يمعود خلصنا، ما ظل شي نسويه.
lines.gloss: Come on, man, we're done; there's nothing left to do.

lines.text: وين رايح هالوقت؟
lines.gloss: Where are you going at this hour?

lines.text: ليش ما گلتلي من البداية؟
lines.gloss: Why didn't you tell me from the start?

lines.text: شنو اسمك؟ واني شلون اعرفك؟
lines.gloss: What's your name? And how am I supposed to know you?

lines.text: منو هذا اللي وياك؟
lines.gloss: Who is that with you?

lines.text: لعد شسوي هسه؟ انطيني فكرة.
lines.gloss: So what do I do now? Give me an idea.

lines.text: صدگ؟ ما اصدگ!
lines.gloss: Really? I don't believe it!

lines.text: انت تدري بالسالفة، مو؟
lines.gloss: You know about the matter, don't you?

lines.text: شوكت ترجع؟ اني انتظرك عالباب.
lines.gloss: When will you be back? I'll wait for you at the door.

lines.text: يا الله! شلون طلع الجو حلو اليوم!
lines.gloss: Wow! How lovely the weather turned out today!

lines.text: عفية عليك! هيچ اريدك!
lines.gloss: Well done! That's how I want you!

lines.text: يا ويلي، نسيت المفتاح بالبيت!
lines.gloss: Oh no, I forgot the key at home!

lines.text: عمري اثنعش سنة، واخوي خمسطعش.
lines.gloss: I'm twelve, and my brother is fifteen.

lines.text: الساعة سبعة ونص، والباص يجي بثمانية.
lines.gloss: It's half past seven, and the bus comes at eight.

lines.text: السعر ميتين وخمسين الف دينار، مو اكثر.
lines.gloss: The price is two hundred and fifty thousand dinars, no more.

lines.text: الموعد الساعة 7:30 يوم 15 من الشهر، والسعر 250 ألف.
lines.gloss: The appointment is at 7:30 on the 15th of the month, and the price is 250 thousand.
lines.notes: The only line with digits on purpose: spoken raw and through the studio's text preparation (prepareLineText), to hear what each does.

lines.text: ثلاث سنين وما شفتك، تگول ثلاثين.
lines.gloss: Three years without seeing you; it feels like thirty.

lines.text: انولدت بسنة الف وتسعمية وسبعة وثمانين، ببغداد.
lines.gloss: I was born in 1987, in Baghdad.

lines.text: باچر اربعطعش شباط، تتذكر؟
lines.gloss: Tomorrow is the fourteenth of February, remember?

lines.text: ابو سلام گال راح يجي بعد العصر.
lines.gloss: Abu Salam said he'll come in the afternoon.
lines.source: authored (Abu Salam is the Iraqi character of The Static Sky in the studio snapshot, char-bc112248bf)

lines.text: حجي محمود وام حسين ينتظروك بالاعظمية.
lines.gloss: Hajji Mahmoud and Umm Hussein are waiting for you in Adhamiya.

lines.text: ساهر وشيماء ونبأ راحوا للكرادة.
lines.gloss: Saher, Shaima and Naba went to Karrada.
lines.notes: Intelligibility line: three first names, two ending in hamza. An MSA reading would be tolerable; the names must be right.

lines.text: يا كرار، گوم شوف منو بالباب.
lines.gloss: Karrar, get up and see who's at the door.

lines.text: زينب وفاطمة جايات من المنصور بالتكسي.
lines.gloss: Zainab and Fatima are coming from Mansour by taxi.

lines.text: گلتلك ميت مرة لا تلعب بالخيط! هسه انگطع.
lines.gloss: I told you a hundred times not to play with the string! Now it's snapped.

lines.text: لا تحچي وياي هيچ! اني مو ولدك.
lines.gloss: Don't talk to me like that! I'm not your boy.

lines.text: لا تخاف حبيبي، اني هنا، ما اروح.
lines.gloss: Don't be afraid, my dear, I'm here, I'm not leaving.

lines.text: عيوني، نام هسه وباچر نحچي.
lines.gloss: My darling (lit. my eyes), sleep now and tomorrow we'll talk.

lines.text: يا بويه، دير بالك على روحك، البرد چا قوي.
lines.gloss: Son (lit. father, said to a child), take care of yourself; the cold is strong, you know.

lines.text: البيت ما بي چاي؟ لعد شلون عايشين احنا!
lines.gloss: No tea in the house? Then how are we even alive!

lines.text: گلتله روح للطبيب، گال الطبيب هو اللي محتاجني.
lines.gloss: I told him go to the doctor; he said the doctor is the one who needs me.

lines.text: شگد تاكل؟ مثل القطار، ما يوگف!
lines.gloss: How much do you eat? Like a train, it never stops!

lines.text: ما ظل احد يسأل عني من راحت امي.
lines.gloss: No one asks about me any more since my mother passed.

lines.text: تعبت... تعبت هواية، وما عندي احد احچي وياه.
lines.gloss: I'm tired... so tired, and I have no one to talk to.

lines.text: اسمع... اكو شي يتحرك ورة الباب، لا تفتحه.
lines.gloss: Listen... there's something moving behind the door, don't open it.

lines.text: والله ماكو شي، بس تعبان شوية.
lines.gloss: Honestly there's nothing wrong, I'm just a little tired.

lines.text: لمن چنت صغير، جدي علمني شلون اصلّح الطيارة بخيط واحد وشوية صبر، وگللي الهوا ما يسمعك اذا تصرخ عليه، بس يسمعك اذا تمشي وياه.
lines.gloss: When I was small, my grandfather taught me how to mend a kite with one string and a little patience, and he told me the wind doesn't hear you if you shout at it, only if you walk with it.

lines.text: اليوم الصبح طلعت من البيت بدري، والشارع كله هادي، بس صوت الباعة وريحة الخبز من الفرن، وحسيت كأن بغداد گاعدة تتنفس وياي.
lines.gloss: This morning I left the house early; the whole street was quiet, only the vendors' voices and the smell of bread from the bakery, and I felt as if Baghdad were breathing with me.

lines.text: ماكو.
lines.gloss: There's none. / Nothing.

lines.text: هسه؟
lines.gloss: Now?

lines.text: لا والله!
lines.gloss: No way!
lines.notes: Same words in MSA; the Baghdadi stress and vowel length decide.

lines.text: شغّل الـ wifi وافتح الـ app، الـ battery خلصت.
lines.gloss: Turn on the wifi and open the app; the battery is dead.
lines.notes: Routed to IndexTTS by the studio rule (MIXED script); spoken only when --indextts is given. The Arabic words must stay Baghdadi and the English words readable.

lines.text: OK ابو سلام، هسه نسوي test للراديو، ready؟
lines.gloss: OK Abu Salam, now we run a test on the radio, ready?
lines.source: authored (The Static Sky's radio, Abu Salam)

lines.text: شغّل الواي فاي وافتح التطبيق، البطارية خلصت.
lines.gloss: Turn on the wifi and open the app; the battery is dead (the same words in Arabic script).
lines.notes: The Arabic-script twin of mix-01, spoken by the Iraqi engine: the A/B for the routing rule (same voice, two engines).

lines.text: عتيگ. كلشي يصير عتيگ.
lines.gloss: Obsolete. Everything turns obsolete. (Elias: "Obsolescence. Always obsolescence.")
lines.source: film: The Static Sky, line-2e2e6225ef, Iraqi rendering by the engineer (the studio line has no textAr)

lines.text: بعده... يشتغل، مو؟
lines.gloss: It's still... working, isn't it? (Najm: "It's still… functional, isn't it?")
lines.source: film: The Static Sky, line-45066aa8a4, Iraqi rendering by the engineer

lines.text: الوشوشة هاي بس حچاية تنتظر منو يحچيها.
lines.gloss: This static is just a story waiting for someone to tell it. (Elias: "Static's just a story waiting to be told.")
lines.source: film: The Static Sky, line-bc1475218a, Iraqi rendering by the engineer

lines.text: هذا... ما يصير.
lines.gloss: This... can't be. (Elias: "That's… not possible.")
lines.source: film: The Static Sky, line-c28636643c, Iraqi rendering by the engineer

lines.text: المارينر... ضاعت بسنة سبعة وثمانين.
lines.gloss: The Mariner... was lost in eighty-seven. (Najm: "The Mariner… it vanished in '87.")
lines.source: film: The Static Sky, line-ddda108a0b, Iraqi rendering by the engineer
lines.notes: Intelligibility of a Western ship name written in Arabic letters.

lines.text: هي عمرها ما راحت.
lines.gloss: She never left. (Elias: "She never left.")
lines.source: film: The Static Sky, line-b00523bf7a, Iraqi rendering by the engineer

lines.text: تكدر تنام ببيتك مثل الناس.
lines.gloss: You could sleep at home like a normal person. (Layla)
lines.source: fixture: The Opening Hour (scripts/v4-fixture.ts → src/domain/sample.ts), s1e1 d1
lines.notes: Written with ك where Baghdadi says /g/ (تگدر): does the engine read it as /g/ or as /k/? A listener decides.

lines.text: البيت ما بي چاي.
lines.gloss: Home has no tea. (Karim)
lines.source: fixture: The Opening Hour, s1e1 d2

lines.text: منو مات؟
lines.gloss: Who died? (Abu Samir)
lines.source: fixture: The Opening Hour, s1e1 d3

lines.text: شيل هذا. هنا ما نسوي هيچ.
lines.gloss: Put that away. We don't do that here. (Abu Samir)
lines.source: fixture: The Opening Hour, s1e1 d4
